title: Model Meta Concierge and release-synthesis pipeline: lightweight probes + changelog curator
author: Maya Singh
description: Motivation: Onboarding new model versions currently requires manual metadata edits, ad-hoc short-profiling runs, and hand-written changelog blurbs. This PR introduces a lightweight 'Model Meta Concierge' service that automates an initial metadata hygiene pass, runs a short compatibility + perf probe, derives a stability score, and synthesizes a concise release note draft for maintainers to review. Scope and components: 1) services/meta_concierge: daemon exposing an onboarding API that accepts model artifacts and metadata and returns a curated metadata bundle; 2) harness/probes/light_probe: 60s micro-profiling runner that executes representative prompt samples (from the model registry seed set) to collect median latency, tail latency (p95), peak GPU memory, and token-level failure signals; 3) release/curator.py: changelog synthesizer using templates + a small rule engine that highlights behavior changes (e.g. reduced latency, quantization artifact risk, altered default tokenizer behavior); 4) schema updates: model-version metadata extended with fields: stability_score, probe_snapshot_url, computed_compat_tags; 5) docs: onboarding.md and a new 'how to review synthesized changelogs' guide. Implementation notes: The probe runs in a constrained environment (1xA10G CPU/GPU sandbox) and collects metrics produced as structured JSON at a single top-level URL. The concierge combines registry metadata, probe snapshot, and historical deltas (if previous versions exist) to compute a 'stability_score' heuristic (0-100) used by rollout tooling. The changelog synthesizer outputs a 1-3 sentence summary plus an optional 'operator action' highlight for breaking or noteworthy changes. Rollout plan: feature gate the service behind registry flag 'meta_concierge.enabled=false' (default off), run in opt-in mode for the next 3 sprints, enable for all new onboardings after one canary cycle. Backwards compatibility: existing model uploads remain accepted; when the concierge is enabled it will annotate metadata in place and create a release draft in /releases/drafts. Testing: added integration test that boots a local concierge instance and verifies probe outputs and synthesized changelog semantics; added unit tests for the stability_score function and template rendering. Checklist: - [x] Service scaffolding and API contract - [x] Probe harness and default sample set - [x] Synthesizer templates and rule engine - [x] Schema migration with a migration script - [x] Integration + unit tests - [x] Docs and reviewer guide - [x] Feature flag gate and rollout notes Related: ENG-4092 (auto-profiling for onboard), ENG-4210 (changelog automation pilot). Merge impact: small schema migration adds optional fields; migration included and is backward safe. Metrics impact: average per-onboard time increases by ~70s while probe runs; expected to be acceptable for manual onboard flows. CI: full test suite passed and one flaky e2e was retried and green.

review_comments: Luca: Can the stability_score be gamed by artificially short probes? Suggest adding a minimum sample threshold.
Maya: Added a minimum-sample config and safety clamp (configurable) in the latest commit; documented tradeoffs in onboarding.md.
Priya: The changelog templates look good but please include a short 'action for infra' when GPU memory increase >10%.
Maya: Added action highlight and a unit test asserting action shows when delta_mem_pct > 10.
Zheng: Suggest we make the probe run non-blocking for HTTP upload flows and add an async callback to the console - we don't want blocking uploads.
Maya: Implemented async callback mode behind feature flag; default remains blocking for opt-in testing.
release_notes: Introduce 'Model Meta Concierge' service to automate initial metadata hygiene, run a short compatibility/perf probe, compute a stability_score, and synthesize a concise release note draft for model versions. Includes schema additions (stability_score, probe_snapshot_url, computed_compat_tags) and tooling to gate rollout. Operator action highlight added for significant GPU memory or latency deltas. Opt-in feature behind 'meta_concierge.enabled' flag; migration script included.
post_merge_tasks: Monitor onboarding time and probe ROI in telemetry dashboard (SLOs)
Schedule one canary run for three months of new onboardings
Add telemetry to detect synthesized-changelog edits
notes_for_reviewers: Pay special attention to migrations/2025_02_add_concierge_fields.sql and pkg/registry/model_metadata.py for backward compatibility. The stability_score algorithm is intentionally conservative; see tests/unit/test_stability_score.py for expected edge cases. The curator rules live in release/curator.py and should be easy to extend; the template is release/templates/brief.txt. If you want to run locally, see scripts/bootstrap_local_concierge.sh for a dev sandbox.
